[Source 1 — www.france24.com (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20261117-%F0%9F%94%B4-israeli-parliament-elects-eisenkot-ally-matan-kahana-as-speaker):
Israeli parliament elects Eisenkot ally Matan Kahana as speaker in blow for Netanyahu

The Israeli parliament on Tuesday elected as new speaker an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, the party leader currently working to form the next government and replace current Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Matan Kahana, a former special forces soldier, is expected as soon as Wednesday to start the process of undoing much of the agenda of Netanyahu.

[Source 2 — www.theguardian.com (Bias: Left / Progressive)] (URL: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/17/israeli-parliament-elects-new-knesset-speaker-backed-netanyahus-opponents):
Israeli parliament elects new speaker backed by Netanyahu’s opponents

Knesset’s appointment of Matan Kahana marks step towards reversing policies of outgoing governmentThe Israeli parliament elected a new speaker on Tuesday, a key step toward rolling back policies passed by the outgoing government led by the prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu.The new speaker is Matan Kahana, an ally of Gadi Eisenkot, the party leader currently working to form the next government and replace Netanyahu.
